purpose: First pre-registered flocqsmith campaign: every format and every op family of the BinarySingleNaN capability profile across several seeds, on lean-meta, lean-ir and lean-kernel against pinned Rocq vm_compute, with a positive-control lane at the same generator revision and the exemplar lane test.

lanes.name: mixed-long
lanes.purpose: longer programs: deeper data flow, more structure per program

lanes.name: wide
lanes.purpose: IEEE-width formats only; the first smoke run drew no binary32 program

lanes.name: tiny
lanes.purpose: tiny formats, where boundaries are dense (precision 1, non-power-of-two emax)

lanes.name: controls
lanes.purpose: all 13 planted Lean-side defects at this generator revision, on a fresh seed (the live test uses seed 5)

coverage_required: every format, op, form, mode and corner, and every (format, op family) cell, on cases judged on every path
